English.Char_Desc_2000:
Vox Reader is a native Windows 10/11 application that turns books and documents into natural-sounding audio completely offline. Powered by lightweight on-device neural voice models, it runs entirely on your local CPU without transmitting text or personal documents to remote cloud servers.
Unlike subscription-based reading apps that charge $10-$15 per month and require constant internet connectivity, Vox Reader operates locally with zero telemetry and offers an honest one-time payment for its Pro tier.
Key Features: - Offline Neural Synthesis: Realistic English voices running natively on-device. - Formats: Reads EPUB, TXT, and pasted articles (Free), plus PDF and Microsoft Word (.docx) documents (Pro). - Synchronized Highlighting: Real-time sentence tracking as audio plays. - Listening Controls: 0.5x to 3.0x playback speed, sleep timer, 15-second skip, and bookmarking. - Privacy-First: Zero cloud dependencies, no account required, and air-gapped security.
